input: Explore imposter syndrome workshops or webinars online

gold.taskTitle: Find and Attend an Imposter Syndrome Workshop Online
gold.taskDescription: Research and sign up for an online workshop or webinar that addresses imposter syndrome.

questions.title: Are you looking to watch or actively participate?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a passive learning format (recorded webinar) or an interactive, live workshop experience.

questions.title: What is your budget for this workshop?
questions.description: Determine if the user is looking for free resources only, or is open to paid workshops and webinars.

questions.title: Do you need this in a specific timeframe?
questions.description: Find out if the user has an urgency or deadline, such as needing it within the next week or month.

questions.title: Is this for personal growth or professional development?
questions.description: Understand the primary motivation — self-improvement, career advancement, or a specific workplace situation.

questions.title: What is your current familiarity with imposter syndrome?
questions.description: Gauge whether the user is a complete beginner or already knows the basics and wants deeper, more advanced content.

questions.title: Do you prefer a solo or group learning environment?
questions.description: Clarify if the user wants a self-paced solo course or a cohort-based workshop where they interact with other participants.

questions.title: Are there any preferred platforms you already use?
questions.description: Find out if the user has an existing account or preference for platforms like Coursera, Eventbrite, LinkedIn Learning, or Udemy.
